page.layout: Printed page with running head at top; left margin holds marginal notes (Tritem., Julius Cæs. ... in Marco, Suidas, Xiphil. in Marco); main text in one column of justified lines, with a heading "SACRA." centred below the text; a final short block of lines at the foot right.

main_text.l: reportavit. Apud SICAMBROS excepti Clo-
doalorum † Farabertus.
In HISPANIA res contra Mauros, quoeam
vaftabant, bene geftæ : & per Lufitaniam tur-
bara, compofitæ funt.
BRITANNI movere quoque bellum,
contra quos Dux Agricola miffus eft.
In SCOTIA fuccefsit * Ethodius.
Ex Claris viris tum fuere, Athenæus, Her-
mogenes, Rhetor, qui anno ætatis decimo octavo
Rhetoricam conscripsit ; vigesimo quarto mor-
tuus eft ; Senno consectus, quasi unus de vulgo
mortuus eft : Vulpitius Apollinaris,
præceptor, cujus pericha in Terentium Scaurus
Hieronymus, quem Marcus fepiffime adiit ;
Rufus Hortensius, prætorii prætectus ; fed propter
rusticitatem, quia in pauperate educatus,
rarum Iporum : Arnaphis Magas, qui invocato
Mercurio in aere, aquam impetravit ;
Hieronymus Rhetor, qui proprium multum Rhetori-
cæ ces sciaentiam, ad Aegypti præfecturam pervenit;
Pinto; Laurentius, &c. Tum etiam
Tiberii * Romani inuidavit, & pedit ex Rome
Lucro Apollinis Cumae in Scirucie ita provinciam
avolio exorta, cum sera terrarum in ut
incident. Memphis faltator, Batylus & Luste-
rianam inveniuntur occurrunt.
SACRA.
ROMÆ intra hoc tempus fedit * Antonius
cetera †, Sotes*, & Eleutherius †, Aureus,
Elerici comam nutrirent, sed deinde caput in
modum.

page.notes: The page is heavily damaged and show-through from the reverse is present; several lines in the centre and right are illegible and have been reconstructed only where legible. Marginal notes are in the left margin; section mark "SACRA." is a heading.
